🔥 शनाया कपूर की नई सीरीज का आ गया है धांसू ट्रेलर, इस बार कॉलेज रोमांस नहीं मर्डर मिस्ट्री देखने को मिलेगी! 😱

🎯 2012 में शुरू हुई Student Of The Year फ्रेंचाइजी अब एक बहुत बड़े ट्विस्ट के साथ लौट रही है।

🎬 JioHotstar की आने वाली इस सीरीज का नाम Student Of The Year – After Dark है, जो St. Teresa के काले सच दिखाएगी।

🔪 ट्रेलर में दिखाई देता है कि St. Teresa की स्टूडेंट आयेशा मलिक की बेरहमी से हत्या कर दी जाती है।

👥 शनाया कपूर इस कहानी में मृतका की ट्विन सिस्टर बनी हैं, जो कॉलेज में आकर इस मर्डर मिस्ट्री को सुलझाएंगी।

🕵️‍♀️ ट्रेलर में बेस्ट फ्रेंड, एक जेलेस साइको रूममेट, एक रिजेक्टेड एक्स और एक परफेक्ट बॉयफ्रेंड को प्राइम सस्पेक्ट बताया गया है।

🏆 इस कहानी में भी सालाना कॉम्पिटिशन है, लेकिन इस बार यह सीक्रेट है और बहुत ज्यादा खतरनाक और इंटेंस है।

🎥 इस सीरीज को धर्मा प्रोडक्शंस ने बैक किया है और रीमा माया ने डायरेक्ट किया है।

📅 यह सीरीज 13 नवंबर से JioHotstar पर स्ट्रीमिंग शुरू करेगी।

👇 क्या आपको लगता है शनाया कपूर इस मर्डर मिस्ट्री को सुलझा पाएंगी? जल्दी से कमेंट्स में बताओ! 💬

ctx.title: Student Of The Year – After Dark Trailer Review: Shanaya Kapoor Walks Through A Familiar Gate For An Entirely Unfamiliar Situation!
ctx.summary:
Shanaya Kapoor steps into the grounds of St Teresa Heritage school. This time there is no dance and drama, but a mystery that needs to be unearthed- Student Of The Year-After Dark trailer review.  
 The post  Student Of The Year – After Dark Trailer Review: Shanaya Kapoor Walks Through A Familiar Gate For An Entirely Unfamiliar Situation!  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
Shanaya Kapoor joins the famed gang of Student Of The Year. But there’s a twist. The franchise was first released in 2012, introducing now-popular actors Alia Bhatt, Varun Dhawan, and Sidharth Malhotra to the world of cinema. Years later, the second part of the film became a debut platform for Ananya Panday and Tara Sutaria. And now, Student Of The Year is back with a major twist.
Student Of The Year was synonymous with the lives of rich college students, living fancy lives filled with dance, music, and masti. But that image is going to change with the upcoming JioHotstar series, Student Of The Year – After Dark. Starring Shanaya Kapoor , the series will explore the grim side of the familiar grounds of St. Teresa’s.
The makers of the series dropped the trailer today. It introduces Aayesha Malik, a student of St. Teresa’s who is brutally murdered. Her twin sister, played by Shanaya Kapoor, decides to unearth the mystery by going to college. The trailer then introduces us to the prime suspects in the crime, one by one. They include the best friend, a jealous psycho roommate, a rejected ex, and a boyfriend who is too good to be true.
And how can Student Of The Year be complete without its annual competition? However, here, the competition is secret and hints that it gets more intense every year. The competition is so intense that people will go to extremes. In the process, Shanaya’s character also faces the heat of the competition, which only makes the premise more exciting.
Shanaya Kapoor has been headlining some interesting projects. She began the year with the survival thriller Tu Yaa Main , co-starring Adarsh Gourav. She put up an impressive performance in the film directed by Bejoy Nambiar. The initial glimpse of After Dark also hints at Shanaya delivering a stunning performance and fitting right into the world. The series also introduces new faces, as the brand is known to do.
After Dark has been backed by Dharma Productions and directed by Reema Maya. The series will start streaming on JioHotstar from November 13.
